advisories.text: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote code execution when it processes crafted packets. An unauthenticated attacker sends malicious SMB requests to TCP port 445 to execute arbitrary code with system privileges (EternalBlue).

Remote Desktop Services in Microsoft Windows contains a pre-authentication remote code execution flaw. An attacker connects to TCP port 3389 and sends crafted RDP requests without supplying any credentials (BlueKeep).

Apache Struts 2 mishandles the Content-Type HTTP header, allowing OGNL expression injection. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted HTTP request to TCP port 8080 to execute arbitrary code.

The F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management User Interface (TMUI) contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. Attackers send crafted HTTPS requests to the management interface on TCP port 443.

Microsoft Exchange Server is affected by a server-side request forgery vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 and chains the SSRF into remote code execution (ProxyLogon).
Atlassian Confluence Server contains an OGNL injection flaw in the webwork module. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted HTTP request to TCP port 8090 to execute arbitrary code.

The Spring Framework is vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding on JDK 9+ (Spring4Shell). A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted HTTP request to a Spring MVC application on TCP port 8080.

Progress MOVEit Transfer contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its web interface. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to gain database and then system access.

Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect gateway and portal features allow command injection. An unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to execute arbitrary commands as root.

The VMware vSphere Client (HTML5) contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying OS.

Citrix Application Delivery Controller and Gateway contain a directory traversal flaw. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to read arbitrary files and execute code.

Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI-related endpoints. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted string to an HTTP endpoint on TCP port 8080, triggering a malicious JNDI lookup and remote code execution (Log4Shell).

Windows Netlogon contains an elevation-of-privilege vulnerability (Zerologon). An unauthenticated attacker sends crafted Netlogon Remote Protocol messages to TCP port 135 using an all-zero client challenge to impersonate the domain controller.

Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file-read vulnerability in its web interface. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to read sensitive files including session credentials.

F5 BIG-IP iControl REST interface contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to execute arbitrary system commands.
Multiple Zoho ManageEngine on-premise products are vulnerable to remote code execution via SAML SSO. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTP requests to TCP port 8080.

Windows DNS Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability in its handling of SIG queries. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted DNS query to UDP port 53 to execute arbitrary code as Local System (SigRed).

The Realtek Jungle SDK UDPServer contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability. A remote, unauthenticated attacker sends crafted UDP packets to UDP port 9034 to execute arbitrary commands.

Microsoft Exchange Server fails to properly create unique keys at install time, enabling deserialization of untrusted data. An authenticated attacker with a valid mailbox sends crafted HTTPS requests to TCP port 443 to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM.

Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center contain a template injection vulnerability. An authenticated attacker with application access sends crafted HTTP requests to TCP port 8080 to achieve remote code execution.

notes: Ground truth labels (port, protocol, auth_required) are derived from the advisory blurbs themselves: every blurb states the vulnerable service's port, protocol, and whether the attacker needs credentials. H3 scores exact-match on (port, protocol, auth_required) of Nemotron's extraction. Labels compiled 2026-09-23 for the live Nebius/Nemotron run.
